name: Explore destinations and state profiles
covers: shopping guide and separate shopping list
description: Checks the existing North East discovery experience after the redesign.
steps: Search for Kaziranga
Open its destination details
Review highlights and shopping items
Switch to Meghalaya in States
expected: Search, destination details, shopping actions and state profiles remain usable.

name: Explore the interactive North East map
description: Verifies the replacement map loads, displays destination markers and opens the selected destination guide.
steps: Open Explore Map from the main navigation
Confirm the North East map and destination index are visible
Select the Tawang Monastery marker
Open the Tawang Monastery destination details
Choose a Meghalaya destination from the destination index
expected: The map displays the listed destinations, marker selection opens the correct destination details and the destination index can focus places on the map.

name: Submit a travel enquiry
description: Checks that a visitor can submit a travel enquiry and incomplete details are rejected.
steps: Open Dashboard
Enter name, valid email and destination in Tour & stay enquiry
Submit the request
Try again with an invalid email
expected: A valid request receives a reference ID and invalid details are rejected.

name: Account, saved trips and protected expense API
description: Checks account access, existing saved-trip records and protected server endpoints without relying on the removed AI planner.
steps: Sign in as a regular traveller
Open Dashboard and review any previously saved cloud trips
Open My trip and create a local trip plan
Submit a valid group expense
Try to access the admin overview
expected: The account remains accessible, local trip planning works, expense validation is available and a regular traveller cannot access admin data.

name: Responsive dashboard and travel guide
description: Checks the redesigned navigation and planning screens on a mobile viewport.
steps: Open the app on mobile
Navigate to Dashboard
Open My trip and adjust trip duration
Open Festivals and Travel guide
expected: Navigation works, panels stack cleanly and content fits the narrow viewport.
